The platforms chapter is built on the chicken-and-egg problem: a platform is worthless to each side without the other, so you lure one side with a cheap or free offer and charge the other. The book’s contrast is exact. Sony subsidised every PlayStation 3 sold, betting on game royalties that came in under estimate.
